candidates.title: Why the Shoebill Hatches Two Chicks and Lets One Die
candidates.concept: The shoebill's head and bill fill two thirds of the frame, pale eye staring at the viewer, looming over a flat nest where a big grey chick shape takes all the fish and tiny Doug in a scruffy grey chick costume (cap on, flat face) sits in the empty half; red arrow to Doug. No pecking, no injured chick, nothing cute
